notes: DOE final technical report (Rice University, Hydrogen Sorption Center of Excellence partner), mostly computational (GCMC, DFT), with one experimental result: H2 surface-excess isotherms at 77 K and 87 K for MSC-30 and BF3/F2-fluorinated MSC-30 (Fig. 10). Judgment call on I1: the isotherms were not measured by the report's own authors. The report says the fluorinated sample was made at Rice and 'returned to Cal Tech for evaluation of hydrogen bonding behavior', and that 'Adsorption data provided by Channing Ahn, Caltech.' (main, p. 10). I treated them as original project measurements by a partner laboratory, since no earlier publication is cited for them. If the resolver holds that partner-supplied data count as quoted from other work, the paper would have no own uptake measurement and the code would be theoretical_only. The report does not name the measurement method or instrument (gravimetric, volumetric or flow); I1 is met on the nature of the data (gas-phase H2 isotherms with isosteric heats), and measurement_method would be unknown. Surface area (3350 m2/g) is given for pure MSC-30 only, with no method; none is given for the fluorinated sample. Other surface-area values (about 1500 m2/g for HiPco SWNT, about 2600 m2/g for the model foam) are not tied to a measured uptake value or are computed. The text on VANTA and HiPco H2 uptake is qualitative with no values. Not a review: it reports project results including data. Not retracted (is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the text). No statement that the uptake values were published before.
